description: Read-only state of the running system for the assistant (v2 P1): engine health, the machine and build environment, one composite snapshot, the audio device.

commands.name: system.health
commands.title: Read the engine health
commands.description: The raw GET /health of the synthesis backend: status, lifecycle, audio driver + fallback, audio watchdog, output_scale state, mode_layout, clipping / peak_level (above full scale = hard clipping, the output is not limited), gate_trip_count, cooperative_launch, listen_mode, single_deck_matrix. The per-turn context digest summarises it; read it whole when the digest is not enough.

commands.name: system.environment
commands.title: Read the machine and build environment
commands.description: GPU (name, VRAM, driver, the driver CUDA version), the engine build the backend runs (pianoidCuda release / debug variant, module build time, installed Pianoid / pianoidCuda package versions), the four repos (branch, short SHA, dirty), Python, OS, the backend pid / port, the audio output map (PIANOID_AUDIO_OUTPUT_MAP: engine channel k plays on ASIO device output map[k]; unset = identity) and the allow-listed PIANOID_* variables. Never credentials or PATH; paths outside the repos read "<set: outside the repos>".

commands.name: system.snapshot
commands.title: Read the full state snapshot
commands.description: One composite read: GET /health + GET /load_settings + the environment (system.environment) + a fingerprint (GPU, build variant, repo SHAs, output map) + the active preset summary (preset.summary). The first read of a "full state" question or a bug analysis.

commands.name: audio.devices
commands.title: Read the ASIO audio device
commands.description: The ASIO host device as the engine sees it: driver, sample rate, buffer, latencies, input / output channel lists. Read only; the measurement session (POST /audio/session) is not exposed.

commands.name: audio.ring_depth
commands.title: Read the audio latency / stability setting
commands.description: The audio ring fill depth (the Latency <-> Stability setting, dev-gh8): requested (chunks of 64 frames, 0 = auto), applied (the depth in effect after the driver floor: ASIO 2 x blocks per host switch, SDL3 16), ring_ms = depth x 64 / sample_rate, driver_latency_ms (the ASIO reported output latency, else one host buffer) and estimate_ms = ring_ms + driver_latency_ms. live false = no engine running.

commands.name: audio.set_ring_depth
commands.title: Set audio latency vs stability
commands.description: Sets the audio ring fill depth in chunks of 64 frames (0 = auto: ASIO max(8, 4 x blocks per host switch), SDL3 16; 2..128 explicit). Lower = less latency (4 = 5.3 ms at 48 kHz) but underrun clicks when a synthesis cycle is late; higher = more stable (16 = 21.3 ms). Applied LIVE to the running audio driver (no reload) and persisted per machine (survives restarts); the driver raises a too-small value to its floor (see applied). Bounds = the parameter rule load_settings.audio_ring_depth (400 parameter_out_of_range outside 0..128). Result = audio.ring_depth + previous + effect.

commands.name: audio.exciters
commands.title: Read the exciter currents
commands.description: The exciter monitor (dev-8f54): its configuration (metered ASIO inputs with scale / unit, per exciter = engine channel: sense_input, board_input, current limit, target) and the latest telemetry: per exciter current RMS / peak, board RMS / peak, output peak dBFS, limiter gain dB, limiting, attacks, latched max, warnings (sensor_silent, map_suspect, input_clipping, limit_floor, uncalibrated, rate_low). enabled false = not metering.

commands.name: audio.exciters_config
commands.title: Set exciter limits and input mapping
commands.description: Partial update of the exciter monitor configuration (validated, saved per machine, applied at once): enabled; inputs merged by index [{index, kind current|board|other, label, scale (units per full scale, null = uncalibrated), unit}]; exciters merged by channel [{channel, name, sense_input, board_input, limit (peak, sense unit; null = no limiter), target (RMS, closed loop), release_ms}] ({..., remove: true} drops one; replace: true replaces the lists; reset: true = defaults); limiter {floor_db, release_threshold, holdoff_switches}; closed_loop {enabled, rate_db_per_s, max_cut_db, max_boost_db}; sensor_check {output_dbfs, min_sense_dbfs, hold_s}; telemetry_hz. Hard confirm: limits and mapping protect the exciters and amplifiers.

commands.name: audio.exciters_clear
commands.title: Clear the exciter limiter
commands.description: Clears the exciter monitor's latched values (max current, min gain, attacks) and puts every limiter gain back to its ceiling.
